description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] Resolve an institutional identifier to the Atlas-MCP record that carries it. Ambiguous matches stay ambiguous. FIND is not READ PRIVATE CONTENT is not MODIFY is not DECIDE is not EXECUTE.

identifier.description: A record identifier, for example one returned by atlas.librarian.find.
